what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Burundi in Kenya: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 24220 Burundian asylum seekers in Kenya, 37.3% of all asylum seekers from Burundi.
Refugees from Burundi, a separate group, live mostly in Tanzania, Rwanda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Burundi in many years from 1995, at war level in some of them.
In its most recent periods the opponents it records include RED-TABARA and FPB from 2014 to 2015, and RED-TABARA and FNL-Ubugabo-Burihabwa from 2019 to 2024.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 52 asylum seekers.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2022 to 2025, and the figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Kenya.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Kenya only.
